text:
dev-docs: Quick heads-up — I'm running a lightweight refresh of the mini onboarding flow this sprint (the 'spark-starter' sample app). Targets: streamline the auth ENV matrix, add a tiny docker-compose example for first-deploy, and fix a couple of stale links. I'll open split PRs so reviews are small. pinging owners for quick reads.
linh: thanks — can you paste the sample repo link? I want to verify the Node snippets still work with SDK 6+.
oscar: I can take the docker-compose bit. There's an old compose file that references port 8088 which the k8s manifest doesn't. I'll align them and add a note about local vs dedicated endpoints.
dev-docs: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/spark-starter (private). I'll include the exact commit in each PR. Plan: PR A = docs updates (links/table/ENV), PR B = docker-compose + tiny smoke test, PR C = code snippet ports & Node update. Small diffs.
talia: found one broken link in the onboarding lab: step 3 links to /sdk/v4/credentials which 404s. Also the ENV table has `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but not the note about target region/header differences for Private deployments.
kevin: can we also add a short callout about Dedicated customers needing the `X-Account-ID` header for some older endpoints? That bit caught a customer.
lisa: I can do the SDK snippet migration to SDK6 for Node and a minimal Python example. Proposed Node sample (short):

```js
// minimal node (SDK6+)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'open-clarion-7b', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```

I'll keep the example synchronous/compact.
linh: for the ENV matrix, can we add a one-column mapping: env var -> meaning -> example value? Right now it's pretty sparse. Also add a troubleshooting row for "auth 401 after rotation".
oscar: docker-compose snippet I plan to add (local dev):

```yaml
version: '3.7'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}
      - REDWOOD_API_HOST=https://api.redwood.ai
    command: npm run dev
```

I'll add a short test script that curls the health endpoint and retries 3x.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — "mini: onboarding - spark-starter link + env table" by dev-docs
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4522 — "mini: docker-compose + smoke test" by oscar
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — "snippets: node sdk6 + python minimal" by lisa
talia: small copy suggestion for the auth section: change "set REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell" -> "export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... (mac/linux) or setx REDWOOD_API_KEY ... (windows)". Also remove the hardcoded `https://api.stage.redwood.ai` link; use a variable example instead.
kevin: added a note on Dedicated headers — please surface it in the "When things differ" box under Deployments.
linh: will review PR 4521 and 4523 tonight. if anyone wants me to run the node snippet locally, tag me.
dev-docs: awesome — assign reviewers in the PRs. I'll squash the tiny fixes into logical commits. Can we merge the link/env PR first so other PRs rebase easily?
oscar: +1 on ordering. I'll wait to rebase docker-compose after link fixes merge.
lisa: FYI the Python minimal example will show both requests and SDK usage; I'll keep the requests example as a one-liner for people who don't want to install the SDK. e.g.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"clarion-mini","prompt":"hi"}'
```

and then SDK example below it.
linh: small nit — the Node sample should include an example of streaming vs non-streaming branches (one-liner note). Otherwise reviewers will ping on that.
dev-docs: noted — I'll add a "see streaming" inline link rather than expand the snippet. Thanks everyone, I think this keeps the PRs reviewable. I'll post back once PR 4521 is merged and tag for rebase.
ci-bot: PR 4521 merged by dev-docs at 1764001275
dev-docs: done — link/env table fixed in main. tagging PR 4522 and 4523 for rebase. thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
oscar: rebased, ran smoke test locally — health check retry logic works. opened tiny follow-up pr to tweak timeout to 6s.
lisa: rebased and updated Node snippet to include minimal error handling. pushed.
talia: updated copy in docs to include Windows shell example and removed stage URL. small typo fix pushed.
kevin: confirmed Dedicated header note added in "When things differ" box. good call.
dev-docs: closing loop — final checklist: docs link/env ✅, docker-compose + smoke ✅, node+python snippets ✅, Dedicated callout ✅. I'll squash the follow-ups into a single commit and cut a release note for the onboarding refresh.
linh: great — thanks all.
